Risk Management and Mitigation • Quality Risk: AI outputs might be inaccurate or unengaging. Mitigation: Maintain humans-in-loop for review, start with conservative content generation, gather student feedback early. • Data/Copyright Risk: Unauthorized use of licensed content. Mitigation: Legal review of sources, use public/open data, ensure model outputs are sufficiently rephrased. Cite official guidelines【45†L75- L84】. • Cost Overruns: Training large models can blow budgets. Mitigation: Use open models when possible; optimize with distillation/quantization; consider HPC credits or

Content Types: • Lecture Material: Aligned with chapters of NCERT and standard reference books. • Theory Notes: Core definitions, laws, formulas (often NCERT provides fundamental theory【17†L70- L78】). • Problem Sets: Algorithmic/numerical practice similar to past papers. • Concept Explanations: Visual aids and intuition (e.g. diagrams, simulations for physics). • Exam Patterns: Official marking schemes, difficulty levels. We will build a curriculum ontology that tags all content by subject, chapter, topic, subtopic, difficulty. This ensures the AI can generate content “per topic” on demand. Source mapping will rely on official lists (e.g. JEE syllabus PDFs, NTA info bulletins) and authoritative textbooks

12. UX and System Architecture Portal Architecture: The system will follow a standard web-app architecture with clear separation of concerns: • Frontend: Web (React/Angular) and mobile (optional) clients. User-specific views: student dashboard, teacher admin panel, content creator interface. Responsive design for desktop/mobile. • Backend/API: Microservices or modular services (e.g. Python Flask/Django or Node.js) exposing RESTful or GraphQL APIs. Key services include user management (auth/roles), content management, video generation service, Q&A engine, analytics service, and content filtering service. • AI/ML Services: Hosted separately (possibly on GPU nodes). For example: • Video Service: generates videos on demand (queues jobs). • NLP Service:

& Mobile App: Allow downloading videos/notes for offline study. These features align with common e-learning platform needs (content delivery, assessment, analytics). Comparison table (below) lists prioritized features for MVP vs later phases: Feature Description MVP Later AI Video Lessons Automated topic-based lecture videos ✓ Topic Summaries/Notes Generated concise study notes per topic ✓ Dynamic Test Series Auto-generated quizzes/exams aligned to syllabus ✓ Q&A and Forum AI Q&A chatbot; discussion forum ✓ Performance Analytics Student progress dashboards, teacher reports ✓ Adaptive Learning Paths Personalized topic recommendations ✓ Multilingual Content English + Hindi (e.g.) materials ✓ Gamification Badges, points, streaks ✓ Live

Executive Summary We propose an AI-driven education portal for JEE/GATE/NEET that offers automatically generated video lectures, topic-wise notes, quizzes, and question banks, supported by teacher and administrator interfaces. Core features include AI-produced instructional videos (with synthesized speech and optional avatar), dynamically created summaries/notes, customizable test series, and a robust question-answer engine. Additional features could include adaptive learning paths, student analytics dashboards, peer Q&A forums, and gamification elements. All content will be strictly constrained to the relevant syllabus through a layered safety system (rules, classifiers, and possible reinforcement learning fine-tuning) to prevent off-topic or inappropriate output. We will train and host
